tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// 'jam dpal la nye bar bsngags pa me tog gi phreng ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhiṃ/ na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ shes bya kun mkhyen chos kyi rgya mtsho tshig dang spobs pa'i rin chen gter 'dzin rgyal ba dang*// rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal 'jig rten gtso bo che bar rab grags de dag gis// yon tan dpag yas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod dbyangs bgrang yas rtag tu sgrogs mod de lta na'ang*// mchog tu dad pas ji ltar spobs bzhin bdag gis kyang ni bstod tshig me tog phreng bas mchod// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes las grub rgyal sras gzhon nu rnam par rol pa 'gying ba'i sku// chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor phyir chos 'chad phyag rgyas thugs rje mtshon byed utpal bsnams// dpa' bo khyod ni bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms mthu stobs brnyes slad rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri dang*// ye shes gsal ba'i skad cig gcig gis shes bya ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen phyir glegs bam 'dzin// rang gzhan don gyi yon tan ma lus yongs su rdzogs slad gser bzang 'bar ba'i mdangs ldan pa// rin chen gyis spras na bzas klubs shing rnam pa sna tshogs sprul pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'gyed// bsod nams yongs rdzogs nyes pas ma gos rang bzhin gyis gsal mi 'jigs bzhi yis bsnyengs bral bas// rin chen khri steng chu skyes bsil zer rnam par bsgyings pa'i seṅge mchog la rol pas bzhugs// chos kyi dbyings dang nyid kyi rigs mtshon mthon mthing ral pa'i thor tshugs mi 'khrugs rgyal bas brgyan// spyan mchog bzang pos 'gro la legs gzigs 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan zhal gyi padmo rgyas pa las// dam pa'i chos sgra bsgrags pa'i dris bsdus rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom bung ba nyer 'khrigs pas// nye bar bsngags pa'i dar dir sgra sgrogs lha dang klu dbang rig 'dzin chos kyis khyod zhabs mchod// bcom ldan khyod ni la la dag na zla ba nya ltar rab tu zhi zhing des pa dang*// 'ga' zhig tu ni rgyan rnams du mas rnam par spras shing nyi ma bzhin du rab tu lham// gzhon nu la lar btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rnam par rol zhing bde ba kun la dgyes dgur spyod// gzhan du 'jigs byed mi bzad tshul 'dzin dus mtha'i me 'od mched pa ltar 'bar phreng bas 'khrig

/kha cig tu ni yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing dang sman sogs 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor 'gyur// la lar gdong bzhi drag po 'jug sred dbang po dang ni 'khor los sgyur rgyal tshul ston zhing*// de bzhin gzhan du dgra bcom rang rgyal rgyal sras du ma'i rnam par bstan nas gzhan yid sgyur// zhing khams la lar rnam par 'dren pa chen por gyur nas rin chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// mgon po khyod kyi rnam 'phrul mtha' yas rgyal bas kyang ni brjod par nus min gang gi phyir// nam mkha' dang ni chos kyi dbyings dang sems can khams bzhin tshad dang bgrang ba las 'das phyir// dbyangs dang gsal byed yi ge'i ma mo brgya phrag phyed rnams bcom ldan khyod kyi gsang sngags lags// de dag las btus sdeb sbyor tha dad las rnams kun byed dpag tu med mod chos kyi sgo// skye med rdul bra don dam de nyid 'chi 'pho med cing mi 'bral mtshon byed yi ge lnga// khyod kyi sngags kun zab mo'i de nyid nges par mtshon phyir chos

rnams kun gyi snying po lags// khyod nyid gcig pu sa gsum dag na rmad du byung bar yongs su grags gyur de slad du// skye bo gang zhig bag yod de dag gdon mi za bar khyod la skyabs su mchi bar bgyid// gang gis lugs bzang dri med de 'dra bla ma'i drin gyis legs par khums pas bdag gi yid// dad pa'i blo gros rnam par 'phel slad mgon po khyod kyi zhabs kyi drung du nye bar lhags// khyod kyi rnam 'phrul mtha' yas ji snyed bdag gi lus kyang de snyed gyur nas khyod bzhugs srid// mchod pa'i sprin phung nye bar bkod pa du mas mchod cing spyi bo'i gtsug gis phyag 'tshal lo// sdug bsngal du mas rab tu nyen pa'i 'gro kun bskyab slad nges pa kho nar skyabs su mchi// ma rig gis ldongs las kyi rlung gis sdug bsngal rba 'khrugs srid pa'i rgya mtshor rab 'phangs nas// nyon mongs chu srin mi bzad khar chud skye dgu 'di dag thugs rje'i phyag gis legs drangs te// thar pa dam pa'i dge legs dpal gyis rnam par rol phyir rnam pa kun tu gsol ba 'debs// thub pa'i gsung rab shin tu gces phyir nyid kyis kyang ni glegs bam rtag tu bsnams mdzad na'ang*// deng sang 'di na che bar khas 'che de dag gis kyang sde snod rgya mtsho rgyang bsrings nas// gdams pa'i thigs pa cung zad tsam la mchog tu lta zhing dam chos smra ba sun 'byin pas// 'gro ba 'di kun mun nag stug pos mngon par khebs gyur 'di la mgon khyod ji ltar dgongs// skye dgu 'di dag ma rungs gyur pa mngon sum mthong bas bdag yid bzod par ma gyur pas// khyod las gzhan pa'i re gnas ma mchis de yi slad du bsam pa thag pas gsol btab kyang*// gal te khyod thugs dgongs mi mdzad na khyod kyi mthu dang thugs rje'i bya ba gang zhig lags// de slad de ltar gsol ba'i don 'di da lta nyid du 'bras bu mchog dang ldan par mdzod// mgon po 'jam dbyangs ye shes rgya mtshor bstod dbyangs tshig gis sa bon rnam par btab pa las// bdag blo'i nyes pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos bsod nams padmo bde legs bcud ldan gang bskrun pa// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs skye dgu'i bung bas dga' mgur spyad pas nyon mongs kyis gzir rgud bral nas// bsod nams lus rgyas ye shes lnga yi bde ba mchog dang rnam pa kun tu ldan gyur cig

/blo mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' bzhin du lus can kun la khyab par bzhugs mod de lta na'ang*// rang gi nyes spyad dbang du gyur pas sdug bsngal khung zhugs blo gros mig bral stobs zhan pas// bcom ldan mthong dang thos pa'i skal med rnam par 'thoms pa de 'dra'i drung du bdag mchis nas// rnam 'phrul bye ba phrag brgya bstan nas khyod kyi legs bshad bdud rtsi'i dga' ston thob byed shog /chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i 'od kyis sa gsum rab gsal bla ma de'i// zhabs kyi padmo cod pan du byed 'phags pa'i ming can blo gros gsal ba'i mig ldan pas// bstod tshig me tog sdeb sbyor mdangs bkra kun nas spel legs snyan pa'i dri bsung dang ldan pas// blo gsal bung ba'i yid rab 'phrog byed me tog phreng 'dis mgon po 'jam dbyangs legs mchod do// 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la ring du sbyangs pas bstan pa'i bya ba dang*/ gzhan gyi don la rab tu brtson pa'i go bgos pa/ rgyal po go pe la zhes bya ba'i bsod nams kyi dpal la mngon par brten nas chos smra ba 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ ri bo rtse lngar mchis nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam par 'phrul ba du ma bstan pas bstod par 'dod pa'i blo gros rnam par 'phel ba dang*/ gzhan yang thar pa chen po'i rgyal mtshan rab tu bsgreng zhing*/ mngon par mtho ba'i dpal 'byor bzang pos skye dgu'i tshogs bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ ri bo rtse lnga de nyid du me mo sbrul gyi lo/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la nye bar bsngags pa me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
